about_the_game:
This DLC is not required to play Caverns and Dryads, nor does it alter the game in any way. But it’s a way to support development and enjoy some extra content.

By purchasing it, you'll receive:

  • The world map in several versions: place names in English, French, Spanish, and another one without names. Resolution: 4664 x 3997 pixels, PNG format. You can print it or view it on your computer. It helps you plan your strategies and routes, and better understand the game world.

  • This DLC will receive updates when the world map expands or changes.

The money collected from this DLC helps to:

  • Acquire hardware and software for game development

  • Cover expenses like the domain name, courses, and personal training

  • Eventually hire the same musician to create exclusive tracks for special chapters

  • Show your support for my work and encourage me to keep building this world

Thank you so much for playing my game. Just knowing that you've played and enjoyed my universe already makes me happy. And by purchasing this DLC, you show love for the game and its world, and your desire to go deeper into it. It’s something so wonderful that I can’t express the immense gratitude I feel. Thank you so much!
----

WHERE IS IT INSTALLED? The files are installed automatically upon purchase. Disk location:

The DLC is installed in the same folder as the base game.

You can find it at: C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Caverns And Dryads\Maps (or your custom installation path)
----
